content: Root cause: The bug was caused by incorrect handling of L3 decapsulation for small inner packets (less than 64 bytes) where extra L2 padding was included in the L3 length calculation. This led to an incorrect update of the L3 length after decapsulation, as the extra padding should not have been considered part of the L3 length. The patch corrects this by ensuring that the new header is added at the beginning of the packet, avoiding hardware reparse and preventing the incorrect update of the L3 length.
